UI.TITLE: Backlog Sections
UI.INTRO: Named sections inside a project's backlog. A header sits above each section's tasks in the backlog panel; drag a task under another header to move it there. Sections and memberships are stored by the plugin; the app's tasks are only reordered, never changed.

STATUS.LOAD_FAILED: The settings could not be loaded: {{error}}

PROJECT.LABEL: Project
PROJECT.BACKLOG_OFF: The backlog is switched off for this project (project settings → Enable backlog). Sections are kept but not shown until it is on.

SECTIONS.HEADING: Sections
SECTIONS.HINT: In this order from the top of the backlog; tasks without a section come last.
SECTIONS.EMPTY: No sections yet for this project.
SECTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM_BODY: The section "{{name}}" is removed. Its {{count}} tasks stay in the backlog, without a section.

TASKS.HEADING: Backlog tasks
TASKS.HINT: Put a task in a section here, or drag it under the section's header in the backlog panel.

OPTIONS.HEADING: Behaviour
OPTIONS.HEADER_BUTTON: Show the Backlog sections button in the app header
OPTIONS.HEADER_BUTTON_HINT: The button appears in project views and opens this page for the current project. A change takes effect after the app restarts.
